dedupe_keys.name: trai telecom subscription data monthly and indian telecom services performance indicators quarterly

description: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India publishes two core statistical series on the Indian telecom market, both based on data from telecom service providers. Each month a press release on telecom subscription data gives wireless and wireline subscribers by service area and provider, urban and rural subscribers and tele-density, broadband subscribers with and without machine-to-machine connections, active mobile subscribers on the date of peak visitor location register, and mobile number portability requests; the July 2026 release, 25 pages, reports 1,354 million telephone subscribers and 1,094 million broadband subscribers. Each quarter, and once a year, 'The Indian Telecom Services Performance Indicators' report (171 pages for January to March 2026) covers subscriptions for access, wireless, wireline and internet services, public WiFi hotspots, PMRTS and VSAT, revenue and usage of wireless services, financial data of the sector, quality of service of wireless, wireline and broadband providers against benchmarks, and cable TV, DTH and radio broadcasting. Coverage: India, by licensed service area (telecom circle) and provider. Format and access: PDF reports on the TRAI website, free. Caveats: provider-reported figures; tables must be extracted from PDF; TRAI disclaims warranty. Simulation uses: subscriber counts by circle for demand and population exposure, and quality-of-service benchmarks for service-level models. Related records: the TRAI drive test and MySpeed records give measured quality, and the India 5G techno-economic model uses such demand inputs.
name: TRAI telecom subscription data (monthly) and Indian Telecom Services Performance Indicators (quarterly)
